steps.say: Click the centre cell to place your first stone. Light joins top to bottom; dark joins left to right, and the centre is strong.
Stones that touch make a chain. Place a stone touching your stone at f6.
steps.tip: Pick one of the six cells around f6.

steps.say: Your chain runs from the top to row 10. One more stone reaches the bottom edge and wins.
steps.tip: Touch f10 and the bottom row at once.
